label: Imprison decline warning
summary: A warning line saying what happens if the one asked to imprison the character fails to do so.
details: The four entries with text in the input say the character will rise in rebellion with their house bloc and other unhappy vassals, rise in rebellion with other unhappy vassals, leave to become a wanderer, or still be the liege's council member (the council post cannot be fired). The other three entries (names mention a head of faith that cannot be fired and cases of no war) show no text in the input. The warning is about the character the custom text runs on; the one who fails is the saved scope 'second'.
